info.title: Binacle.Net Service
info.description:
**Binacle.Net Service API**

This api is designed only for when Binacle.Net is used as public service.

[View on Github](https://github.com/binacle-labs/Binacle.Net)

[🐳 Binacle.Net on Dockerhub](https://hub.docker.com/r/binacle/binacle-net)
